description: Angular component for a filter selection UI element, including form handling, filter fetching, and user interaction logic.

classes.name: FilterSelectComponent
classes.description: Angular component implementing a filter selection dropdown with form control, filter fetching, and user interaction.

methods.name: registerOnChange
methods.description: Registers a callback function to propagate changes to the form control.

methods.name: registerOnTouched
methods.description: Registers a callback for when the control is touched.

methods.name: onFocus
methods.description: Handles focus event, updates validation if needed.

methods.name: updateView
methods.description: Updates internal model and propagates change.

methods.name: displayFilterFn
methods.description: Returns display string for a filter object.

methods.name: fetchFilters
methods.description: Fetches and filters the list of filters based on search text.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears the input field and resets the filter selection.

methods.name: textIsNotEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the provided text is non-empty.

methods.name: filterEnter
methods.description: Handles Enter key press to create a new filter if none selected.

methods.name: createFilter
methods.description: Creates a new filter via callback and updates the selection.

methods.name: loadFilters
methods.description: Loads filters from aliasController into internal list.
